$comment: CLA signature ledger. See CLA.md for the agreement and what it does and does not grant.
To sign: add an entry to `signatures` in the same pull request as your first
contribution, then keep contributing. Your commit authorship is the signature —
it records that you, under your own GitHub account, agreed to CLA.md.
`username` must match your GitHub login exactly and is compared case-insensitively.
Entries are append-only. Removing one revokes nothing already granted — the CLA
licence is irrevocable by its own terms — it just breaks the audit trail.
